description: Portrait-faithful character art translated into the readable 16-bit pixel language of Modia's legacy battle sprites.

identityAuthority.player: Each variant's canonical portrait is authoritative for race, face, hair, class palette, costume cues, and equipment. The approved dwarf-female and dwarf-other anchors override only contradictory gender presentation and body silhouette.
identityAuthority.enemy: The canonical NPC reference and primary visual identity are authoritative across every spawn zone.
identityAuthority.fallback: Legacy class and biome sprites are pose/style fallbacks only; they must not overwrite a portrait or NPC identity. Deterministic player compilers preserve every valid existing canonical asset unless a targeted --force is explicit.

artDirection.silhouette: compact, full-body, side-readable fantasy RPG sprite with separated equipment and visible feet
artDirection.linework: bold dark ink-like pixel outlines with intentional one-pixel edge clusters
artDirection.color: muted watercolor-and-parchment palette translated into pixel ramps; retain portrait accent colors
artDirection.lighting: warm top-left key light with restrained highlights and readable shadow groups

canonicalReferenceContract.source: The identity's canonical high-quality portrait supplies the head, upper-costume detail, class palette, and equipment cues; deterministic race, gender, and class profiles complete one full-body 64px subject.

safety.scopeRequired: Exactly one of --id, --sample, or --all is required.
safety.bulkGate: Bulk compilation is available only through an explicit --all.
safety.existingAssetPolicy: Preserve every existing canonical reference unless --force is explicit.
safety.writePolicy: Write canonical PNG and provenance atomically.
safety.validation: Require 512x512 lossless RGBA, transparent corners, generous margins, one dominant full-body subject, source/output hashes, deterministic bytes, and cross-identity uniqueness.

identityOverrides.reason: The canonical dwarf-female portrait cohort is strongly male-coded and contradicts female identity metadata; the approved neutral anchor supplies the feminine face and full-body silhouette while each class portrait remains the palette and costume-cue source.

The canonical dwarf-other portrait cohort is strongly male-coded and contradicts androgynous identity metadata; the approved neutral anchor supplies the androgynous face and full-body silhouette while each class portrait remains the palette and costume-cue source.

spriteContract.directionPolicy: Mirror the right-facing temporal strip for west-facing runtime directions.
spriteContract.edgePolicy: hard pixel edge with transparent matte; no colored fringe

canonicalAnimationContract.motion: Deterministic temporal pose transforms, stride segmentation, class-readable effects, and fixed per-identity effect palettes create eight genuinely temporal frames from the canonical reference.
canonicalAnimationContract.validation: Validate 64x512 geometry, eight 64x64 frames, lossless alpha, transparent margins, frame coverage, action-specific centroid motion, temporal uniqueness, cross-output hash uniqueness, and generatedAnimations metadata parity.
canonicalAnimationContract.safety: Exactly one of --id, --sample, or --all is required; existing valid strips are preserved unless --force; writes are staged and atomic; registry changes are guarded against concurrent overwrite.

generationPolicy.batchPolicy: Run scoped samples and the semantic test matrix before either explicit --all compiler command. Never promote a diffusion batch by inspection shortcut.

candidateGeneration.technicalGate: Automatic candidate checks cover RGBA dimensions, foreground coverage, background-like rows, transparency, and dominant connected subject.
candidateGeneration.semanticGate: A human must audit portrait identity, race/gender/class fidelity, complete head-to-toe anatomy, costume and palette, single equipment instances, clean transparent matte, and absence of scenery before promotion.
candidateGeneration.promotionGate: Promotion requires --promote and at least one explicit --id; there is no bulk promotion command.
candidateGeneration.canonicalPolicy: A staged diffusion candidate is not canonical and must not update runtime metadata or replace deterministic/golden art before explicit targeted promotion.

goldenReferences.preservationPolicy: Accepted golden baseline. Bulk deterministic compilers and diffusion staging preserve it; replacement requires a targeted --force plus a new manual semantic audit and updated hashes.
goldenReferences.prompt: Create one full-body pixel-art human male warrior matching the identity portrait: blond hair, short blond beard, fair human features, white-and-gold plate armor, blue underlayer, red scarf, one shield, and one sword. Use the legacy warrior only for readable game-sprite silhouette and compact pixel proportions. Hand-authored 16-bit pixel art, crisp hard-edged pixels, bold dark ink-like outlines, restrained highlights, muted watercolor-and-parchment palette, centered full body facing right on a flat chroma-key background; no redesign, scenery, shadow, text, duplicate equipment, soft antialiasing, anime, chibi, 3D, or photorealism.
